ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85:15 high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) distribution across the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity white field across the interior lobes. Contiguous low-intensity black banding (5-15 pixel width) along the entire trailing edge boundary. A vertical, low-intensity column of irregular dark pixel clusters originates at the median notch and extends toward the base. Small, isolated circular dark pixel clusters are located at mid-lobe coordinates on both the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with an approximate 70-degree aperture; vertex is sharply defined.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern along the continuous trailing edge; pixel-amplitude of peaks and valleys varies between 3 and 8 pixels relative to the mean edge line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge leading to distal tips, with a sharp transition into a convex outer margin.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, dark circular pixel clusters (3-5 pixel diameter) distributed across the white field, notably one in the left-central lobe and three in the right-central lobe, consistent with remnant colonization points.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent vertical dark pigmentation streak and mottle cluster extending ventrally from the median notch vertex toward the water line.
